current_grouping: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop

versions.grouping_at_time: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle cargo restraint system is designed to resist dynamic loads and prevent movement of the cargo and payload in each principal direction during aerial delivery (air transport and airdrop), ensuring the cargo remains securely positioned and restrained throughout the operation, IAW MIL-STD-1791, Loads and Restraint paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct loads and strength analysis to verify the air vehicle restraint system can restrain entire cargo and payload capacity of the air vehicle to meet aerial delivery requirements. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct a ground demonstration to verify air vehicle restraint system can restrain the entire load capacity in all required directions and configurations of the cargo in the air vehicle.
  (2) For items intended for airdrop operations, demonstration includes airdrop systems and release mechanisms. Test.
    (1) Ground test: Perform restraint system testing to verify the air vehicle restraint systems and restraint subsystem components (mechanisms) required for operation of those systems will withstand forces required to secure the cargo and payload IAW MIL-STD-1791, Loads and Restraint paragraph.
